course.title: CAM and Robotics Sessional
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: Write a part program in APT language to make the part ABCDEFG from sheet IJKL by a CNC machine considering, i) program is in absolute mode, ii) program begins from reference point at the bottom left edge of sheet iii) program is counterclockwise (points A-B-C-D-E-F-G-A) iv) material is aluminum. All dimensions are in mm. Assume relevant data if required. Sheet is 5 mm thick.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2015
